CORRECTED (integration, SD31-W3-INTEGRATE-001): the prior wording here also claimed 'and the declared-PI reader' -- adversarial review confirmed that is false. `ingest_races.rs`'s two record writers (both the race chassis writer and its own race_trait writer, the ones that wrote all 10 Skinwalker records) hardcode `pi_field: None` unconditionally and never call `pi_screening::declared_product_identity`; that reader is wired only in the separate `ingest_race_traits.rs` binary, which did not touch this book's Skinwalker rows. No PI actually leaked (`skinwalker_abilities_race*.lst` carry zero `DESCISPI:`/`NAMEISPI:` tokens, confirmed by grep), so this book's 65 records remain genuinely clean, but the claim about the mechanism was inaccurate and is corrected here rather than left standing.
